name: tanstack-start-solid
description: SSR Solid app scaffolded with TanStack Start (Solid) and TanStack Router.

generatedFiles.description: Project-local Solidiom config (positioning adapter, source/runtime dirs, install mode) so the generated project is immediately `solidiom add`-able.

notes: This file is documentation/metadata only — materialize.ts's actual copy-and-substitute behavior is the source of truth for what gets written into a generated project.
`{{projectName}}` is the only substitution token used in this template's source files (the page title rendered by src/routes/__root.tsx).

SSR-specific structure: src/router.tsx is the router setup file. Its router-creation function MUST be exported as `getRouter` (not `createRouter`) — TanStack Start's internal hydration code does a named `{ getRouter }` import from this file, and any other export name fails the build with a MISSING_EXPORT error.

src/routes/__root.tsx is the root route, rendering the document shell and an <Outlet/> — there is no index.html in the client-only-template sense, since TanStack Start generates its own HTML shell from the root route.

Routes are file-based under src/routes/ (index.tsx, about.tsx) and are compiled into src/routeTree.gen.ts by the tanstackStart() Vite plugin — that generated file is not part of this template's payload.
